notes: The fourth thereof is correctly added: ha-qesawoth is written with an article but no pronominal suffix, where the dishes, spoons and bowls each carry one, and the article has already taken the written the (rules 18, 30, 41).
asher ... bahen is rendered by the single word wherewith, a three-morpheme unit headed on the relative (rules 22, 30).
which were upon takes its copula on the preposition heading the verbless relative clause (rule 49).
